Session fixtures for internal/graph/session (W-M4.2). Generated; never edited by hand.

Source: the raw set fixtures-m4-2026-11-12, 42 recorded AutoSteer eval runs (T1, T1b, T1c), one
session each, 77 files of store/runs/<sid>/records.ndjson and steer.ndjson. The raw set and its
generator (mkfix.py) live outside the repository, in the owner's docs-out tree. The raw set holds
prompt words, model words and home paths, and it never enters the repository.
Raw SHA256SUMS.txt sha256: d4967c26349beb83bad1c29c4ad1e866be6ef41b7fa2416215361c11454c4afe

Cut: each line is cut to the decoders' keys, with paths outside the run's tree replaced. The keys are
keys.txt, every json tag recordHead and steerHead read, the one list both the generator and
TestFixtures_KeysAreTheDecodersTags read. A key the decoders do not read is dropped from every line,
whatever its record type.

Replacement rule (ruling 2026-11-12 14:09): an absolute file_path or written_paths entry becomes the
marker "/outside" when it lies under neither the line's project nor its cwd, compared as text both as
written and after a leading /private is removed from all three. No filesystem is read. A path either
comparison keeps is verbatim. The decoder (inProject) places every replaced path outside the project,
as it placed the original, so each line decodes to the same Event. Writes through the /tmp alias of a
/private/tmp project are kept verbatim (29 paths, all in t1c-r6). They decode as outside today, and
TestFixtures_KnownHoleT_AliasWritesDecodeOutside pins that by name, so the path fix (debt (t)) moves
it there.
Replaced per run (38 in all): t1c-g1 3, t1c-g12 1, t1c-g13 1, t1c-g15 2, t1c-g18 3, t1c-g19 4, t1c-g20 1, t1c-g3 1, t1c-r6 22

Lines: records 12919, steer 487. Bytes: raw 13725008, cut 1445228.
Layout: stores/<run>/runs/<sid>/records.ndjson and steer.ndjson. SHA256SUMS.txt lists each with its
sha256, paths relative to this directory.
Cut SHA256SUMS.txt sha256: 88d4ca402b29f2fb2d3aff428a0d9d92410a4ded229a00145a02cba48ae9f345

Ids: each of the 88 session and prompt ids of the raw set is replaced, in the cut lines and in their
paths, by 00000000-0000-4000-8000-<n in 12 hex digits>, n counted from 1 in the byte order of the real
ids, so a sort over ids keeps its order and every id keeps its length. The table from real id to
placeholder stays outside the repository with the raw set.

Limit: the recorded runs hold no session record and no ledger line. They exercise writes, Stop
checkpoints, steer lines and prompts only. Verdict, obligations, met_once by ledger and boundaries are
covered by synthetic tests only, until a session is recorded with the ledger writer in place; a
refresh of this set is owed then.
